subtitulo: ¿Cuál quieres, la roja o la azul?
regla: Put an article (el, la, los, las, un, una…) before an adjective and it works as a noun: el rojo = the red one, los jóvenes = young people. The adjective keeps the gender and number of the noun it replaces. Spanish never adds a word for 'one'.

bloques.texto: In English you say _the red **one**_, _the new **ones**_. In Spanish you just drop the noun and keep **article + adjective**.
The adjective still **agrees** with the noun you dropped: _la camisa roja_ → **la roja**; _los zapatos nuevos_ → **los nuevos**.
It also works with **uno, una, este, ese, otro**: **uno rojo**, **una grande**, **este azul**, **otro barato**. Note **un** becomes **uno** when the noun is dropped.
With people, it names a group: **los jóvenes** _(young people)_, **los ricos** _(the rich)_, **un mexicano** _(a Mexican)_, **la mayor** _(the oldest girl)_.
Tip: think of the noun as invisible. It's still there, and the adjective still obeys it.

lista.es: No quiero la tabla corta, prefiero ==la larga==.
lista.en: I don't want the short board, I prefer the long one.

lista.es: ¿Te gustan estos tenis? —Me gustan más ==los blancos==.
lista.en: Do you like these sneakers? —I like the white ones better.

lista.es: Mi hermana ==la mayor== vive en Ensenada.
lista.en: My oldest sister lives in Ensenada.

lista.es: ==Los jóvenes== de mi colonia juegan futbol en la calle.
lista.en: The young people in my neighborhood play soccer in the street.

lista.es: Este jitomate está verde; dame ==uno rojo==.
lista.en: This tomato is green; give me a red one.

lista.es: ==Los ricos== no hacen fila en la garita.
lista.en: The rich don't wait in line at the border crossing.

lista.es: De las dos cervezas, ==la oscura== es mejor.
lista.en: Of the two beers, the dark one is better.

lista.es: Hay ==una nueva== en la clase de jiu-jitsu.
lista.en: There's a new girl in the jiu-jitsu class.

lista.nota: The adjective already means the people.

lista.texto: Getting the ending right: [[6013|masculine and feminine adjectives]] and [[6014|plural adjectives]].
Demonstratives do the same trick: [[6055|esto, este, esta = this one]].
Numbers can drop the noun too: [[6672|numbers as pronouns]].
The neuter version, _the good thing_: [[6979|lo + adjective]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I want the big one_ (la casa).
In Spanish: _The old ones are better_ (los carros).
